description: This file defines the 'Process' class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing an interface for process management including launching, killing, and checking process status, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux. It also includes a nested 'Options' class for constructing command-line arguments.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: Represents a system process, providing methods to launch, terminate, and query process status, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Linux.

classes.name: Process::Options
classes.description: Helper class to construct command-line options and arguments for launching processes.

methods.name: Process::Options::Command
methods.description: Returns the command to execute.

methods.name: Process::Options::Erase
methods.description: Removes a specific option from the options list.

methods.name: Process::Options::Clear
methods.description: Clears all options.

methods.name: Process::Options::Add
methods.description: Adds a new option or parameter.

methods.name: Process::Options::Get
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the options.

methods.name: Process::Options::LineSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the command line string.

methods.name: Process::Options::BlockSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the argument array for process launch.

methods.name: Process::Options::Line
methods.description: Constructs the command line string into a buffer.

methods.name: Process::Options::Block
methods.description: Constructs the argument array into a buffer.

methods.name: Process::Launch
methods.description: Starts the process with specified options, returning an error code.

methods.name: Process::Kill
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: Process::WaitProcessCompleted
methods.description: Waits for the process to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Process::Id
methods.description: Returns the process ID.

methods.name: Process::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the process is currently active.

methods.name: Process::HasConnector
methods.description: Checks if the process has an input/output connector.

methods.name: Process::Input
methods.description: Returns the input handle.

methods.name: Process::Output
methods.description: Returns the output handle.

methods.name: Process::Error
methods.description: Returns the error handle.

methods.name: Process::IsKilled
methods.description: Checks if the process was killed.

methods.name: Process::IsTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the process has terminated.

methods.name: Process::Input (platform-specific)
methods.description: Writes data to the process input.

methods.name: Process::Output (platform-specific)
methods.description: Reads data from the process output.

methods.name: Process::Error (platform-specific)
methods.description: Reads data from the process error output.
